rows.zh_candidate: @The_monster@说：“我想我死了……我想我已经死了……”

rows.zh_candidate: VISUAL:@The_monster@发出咯咯声，说不出话来。

rows.zh_candidate: @The_monster@说：“我也曾美丽过。你看看我现在。”

VISUAL:Hollow, blind eyes appear on @the_monster_possessive@ head.
rows.zh_candidate: VISUAL:@the_monster_possessive@头上出现了空洞而失明的眼睛。

rows.raw: VISUAL:@The_monster@ looks at @possessive@ body and cries without tears.

rows.zh_candidate: @The_monster@尖叫道：“我只是一个病态、怪异、被毁了容的造物。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ chants, "Know when to hold 'em, know when to fold 'em..."
rows.zh_candidate: @The_monster@吟唱着：“该抓牌时抓牌，该弃牌时弃牌……”
